title: Scoot: Melbourne to Athens One-Way from $573 (July 2026) @ Sky Spy
body:
Deal: Scoot: Melbourne to Athens One-Way from $573 (July 2026) @ Sky Spy

[JamesLucas] Best flight deal Ive probably had was on that route. Sep 2022. $260aud.
[Skyspy] Wow thats amazing, hopefully we can find something like that soon!!
[VantageXL] Same, although mine was in Oct 2022 and I think I paid a little over $300.
I had a 20+ hour stopover in Singapore which was pretty brutal but well worth it for the price.
[Skyspy] Those stopover's can certainly test you hahaha
[Skyspy] Looks like the price is starting to jump on kiwi.com to $620, still an absolute steal if you ask me!
[Andry] Anything similar from Sydney for mid-late September?
[TEER3X] Should be able to fly to Perth for that price.
[Skyspy] I had a look and found SYD —> Vienna for $607.05
https://skyspy.deals/?date=2026-09-20&from=SYD&to=VIE
You can use our Syd -> all of europe search function to find ever more if youd like!!
[Traya1] Is this even that good of a deal for Scoot? I remember seeing Perth > Athens for like $270 last year (one way) and return flights for <$600
I get that fuel prices are higher, but surely the drop in demand will have to make them drop prices
[Skyspy] For peak times and list minute this is very good in todays economy!!
